_about: Skinned characters made by tools/build_character.py. All share one 22-bone skeleton and one animation set. 'player' is who you play. 'walk_anim_speed' is the walking speed (m/s) the Walk loop's stride matches for that body; 'label_height' is where floating text sits above them. 'model_procedural' keeps the earlier generated body for comparison; Nora's 'model' is the image-to-sculpt body (tools/rig_sculpt.py) on the same rig.
